bundle.shortDescription: Corsair lighting, key bindings and onboard memory for Linux
bundle.longDescription: Prism controls Corsair keyboards, mice and lighting controllers on Linux: lighting effects across every device, key and button bindings, macros, DPI, and saving profiles to the devices' own memory. It also lights MSI graphics cards and ASUS Aura motherboards. AI-written; see the README.
